Keep the 'EVOLVEX · INSIGHT' label, the light pink background, the evolvextechnologies.com footer text, and the evolvex logo in the bottom-right corner exactly as shown — do not alter, move, or duplicate them. Fill the large empty content panel in the middle with a clean premium infographic on a soft light mauve background: four hexagonal nodes in a gentle arc, each with a dark plum interior and thin pink/purple glowing border, containing a simple white line icon and short white label: 'Content Ops' (film clapperboard icon), 'Rights & Royalties' (balance scales icon), 'Localization' (globe icon), 'Ad Ops' (bar chart icon).
